f80.notes: Popular forged daily staggered fitment for F80/F82. 18x10 ET40 can also be used in the rear for an exact match of the factory offset.
Clears CCB. 19x10 ET40 can also be used in the rear for an exact match to the factory rear wheel width and offset.
f80.tireFlags: Factory tire sizes · Direct fit · Clears CCB

f80.notes: Clears CCB. Alternative tire setup: Front 255/30-20 // Rear 295/30-20 — tires will be slightly stretched. All-season options N/A on the alt; Max: Michelin Pilot Sport 4S (300TW), Falken Azenis FK510 (300TW); Extreme: Pirelli P Zero (220TW).

Popular fitment. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance. An 18x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance. Wider alternative tires: 285/35-18 front & rear — typically direct fit; a small increase in negative camber may be required if lowered and/or the tire model runs wide.

Clears CCB. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance. A 19x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance.

Popular fitment. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance. An 18x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance. Wider alt: Front 275/35-18 // Rear 315/30-18 — may require rolled rear fenders and/or additional rear negative camber. Narrower alt: Front 265/35-18 // Rear 295/35-18 — direct fit (Max: Continental ExtremeContact Sport; Extreme: Yokohama Advan A052).

Popular fitment. Clears CCB. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. A 19x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance. Narrower alt: Front 265/35-19 // Rear 305/30-19 — taller fronts; rubbing may occur with wide-running compounds at full steering lock (opens more R-compound options including Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2, Pirelli Trofeo R, Goodyear Supercar 3R, Toyo R888R, Nankang AR-1).

f80.notes: Popular fitment. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance.

Adjustable camber plates required. 18–25mm front spacers required depending on tire size/model and suspension. Motorsport-oriented coilovers with a slim spring silhouette and favorable lower spring perch location required. Wider alt: 305/645-18 front & rear — min. −3° front camber, rear direct fit (Pirelli DH slick). Narrower alt: 275/35-18 front & rear — min. −2.5° front camber, rear direct fit.
f80.tireFlags: Min. −3° front camber · rear direct fit · camber plates + spacers required

f80.notes: Adjustable camber plates required. Rear will require fender rolling/pulling. 3mm or 5mm front spacers may be required depending on tire size/model and suspension. Motorsport-oriented coilovers with a slim spring silhouette and favorable lower spring perch location required. Wider alt: 305/645-18 — min. −3° front / −2.5° rear (Pirelli DH). Narrower alt: 275/35-18 — same camber mins.
f80.tireFlags: Min. −3° front / −2.5° rear camber · fender roll/pull rear

f80.notes: Adjustable camber plates required. 12mm front spacers are typically required depending on tire size/model and suspension. Motorsport-oriented coilovers with a slim spring silhouette and favorable lower spring perch location required. Staff pick uses 305/645-18 slick package. Wider alt: 315/30-18 front & rear. Narrower alt: 295/30-18 front & rear — same camber mins.
f80.tireFlags: Min. −3.6° front / −2° rear camber · camber plates + spacers required

f80.notes: Popular fitment. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. An 18x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance. Wider alt: Front 275/35-18 // Rear 315/30-18 — may require rolled rear fenders and/or additional rear negative camber. Narrower alt: Front 265/35-18 // Rear 295/35-18 — direct fit (Extreme: Yokohama Advan A052).

Adjustable camber plates required. 3mm or 5mm front spacers are often required depending on tire size/model and suspension. Motorsport-oriented coilovers with a slim spring silhouette and favorable lower spring perch location required.
f80.tireFlags: Min. −3° front / −2° rear camber · camber plates required

f80.notes: Popular fitment. Clears CCB. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. A 19x9.5 ET15 front can be used to avoid running spacers due to its superior inner clearance. Wider alt: Front 295/30-19 // Rear 315/30-19 — min. −3° front / −2.5° rear camber (Extreme: Continental ExtremeContact Force; Semi-slick: Hoosier A7 / R7). Narrower alt: Front 265/35-19 // Rear 305/30-19 — direct fit with broader R-compound options.

g20-g21.notes: Popular forged square fitment for G2X/G4X. 3–5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance. Wider alternative tire: 255/30-20 front & rear (direct fit, X-Drive compatible; all-season / extreme options N/A on the wider size).
g20-g21.tireFlags: Direct fit · X-Drive compatible · small front spacers may be needed with tire models that run wide

g20-g21.notes: Prioritizes rear-end grip/traction. Alternative #1 tire setup: 255/30-20 front // 275/30-20 rear — direct fit, RWD only (not X-Drive compatible), summer-focused.
g20-g21.tireFlags: X-Drive compatible · small front spacers may be required with tire models that run wide

g20-g21.notes: Popular forged 18" square fitment. 3–5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance. Alternative tire: 245/45-18 front & rear (direct fit, X-Drive compatible).

Popular forged 19" square fitment. 3–5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. Narrower alternative: 245/35-19 front & rear (direct fit, X-Drive compatible) with broader extreme / R-compound options.
g20-g21.tireFlags: Direct fit · X-Drive compatible · 3–5mm front spacers may be required depending on suspension

g20-g21.notes: 5mm front spacers may be required with OEM suspension and tire compounds that run wide. 5–12mm front spacers required with aftermarket coilovers that reduce inner clearance. Alternative tire: 255/35-19 front & rear (X-Drive compatible; ~3mm front spacers recommended; suggested camber about -2.2° front / -1.8° rear).
g20-g21.tireFlags: X-Drive compatible · 5mm front spacers recommended for most tires · additional negative camber required (min. about -2.2° front / -2.0° rear)

g20-g21.notes: Alternative #1: 245/45-18 front // 275/40-18 rear — tight inner clearance between strut and front tire; small front spacers may be needed with wide-running tires. 3–5mm front spacers may also be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. That alt is X-Drive compatible.
g20-g21.tireFlags: Direct fit · not X-Drive compatible · 3–5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions

g20-g21.notes: Popular forged staggered fitment. 3–5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions that reduce inner clearance.

Alternative #1: 255/35-19 front // 275/35-19 rear — typically direct fit with street tires; moderate front negative camber needed with compounds that run wide. Not X-Drive compatible. Extreme: Yokohama AD08R / A052. R-compound: Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2. Alternative #2: 255/35-19 front // 295/30-19 rear — typically direct fit with street tires; moderate front camber for wide compounds; rear may poke or rub when lowered with wide-running tires. X-Drive compatible.
g20-g21.tireFlags: Alt #1 not X-Drive · Alt #2 X-Drive compatible · camber/fitment notes apply when lowered or on wide compounds

g20-g21.notes: Purpose-built drag / traction rear. The 17x10 ET35 clears both M and non-M rear calipers as a direct bolt-on. Pair with an 18x9 ET25 (or other Fortune Forged street front) for a staggered strip setup. Optimized for wider, taller rear tire packages under hard acceleration.
g20-g21.tireFlags: Rear clears M & non-M calipers · direct bolt-on · drag / traction focused

e90-e92-e93.notes: Popular fitment. Front 275/35-18 tires can also be used. Rear 295/35-18 tires can be used but may require rolled fenders to prevent rubbing.

Another popular staggered fitment that is a touch more aggressive than the 9.5/10.5 setup. About as wide as the front and rear fenders will take without extensive modifications — typically bolt-on. We typically do not recommend exceeding a 295 rear tire unless the car has a substantial power bump (supercharged / stroker). 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions for inner clearance. Front tires may lightly scrub inner fender liners at full lock; this usually self-clears over time.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: May require rolled rear fenders · Popular aggressive stagger

e90-e92-e93.notes: Rear can also be run at ET25 depending on design. Rear 295/30-19 tires can be used but may require rolled fenders to prevent rubbing.

5mm or larger front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions for inner clearance. A 19x9.5 ET22 front can be used to avoid those spacers. Rear rolled fenders may be required to prevent rubbing.

Native ET28 rear replaces the common ET44 + 15–18mm rear spacer flush package (ET44 − 16mm ≈ ET28), so the wheel sits flush without spacers. 305/25-20 rear tires can also be used but rear fender rolling and/or additional negative camber may be required.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: Flush without rear spacers · native ET28 rear

e90-e92-e93.notes: Popular fitment. Direct fit, but a 5mm front spacer may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions for inner clearance.

Uses all available real estate under the fender arches — coilovers with linear race springs are a must for inner clearance (JRZ, MCS, Ground Control, AST, Moton, etc.). Also popular with 275/35-18 R-compounds or slicks for sidewall support.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: Requires −3° or more front camber · race-spring coilovers required

e90-e92-e93.notes: Direct fit, but a 5mm front spacer may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions for inner clearance.
Popular fitment. Front 275/35-18 tires can also be used. Rear 295/35-18 tires can be used but may require rolled fenders to prevent rubbing.

Popular aggressive stagger — typically bolt-on without extensive mods. Do not exceed a 295 rear unless the car has a substantial power bump. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. Front tires may lightly scrub inner liners at full lock (usually self-clears).

Most aggressive staggered fitment in the lineup — reserved for serious track/race cars or high-power builds. Native ET29 rear replaces the common ET44 + 15mm spacer package (effective ET29) used to clear the subframe and improve fender clearance vs ET25. 295/35-18 rears may also be used. Many drivers remove rear fender liners to avoid contact. Even at this offset, rear tires may still contact the subframe under full droop (e.g. on a lift). 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. Front tires may lightly scrub liners at full lock.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: May require rolled rear fenders · native ET29 rear (no spacer)

e90-e92-e93.notes: Front 275/30-19 tires can also be used as a direct fit. Rear 295/30-19 tires can be used but may require a touch of negative camber or rolled fenders.
Popular fitment. Direct fit, but a 5mm front spacer may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions for inner clearance.
Coilovers with linear race springs are a must for inner clearance. Also popular with 275/35-18 R-compounds or slicks for sidewall support.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: Requires −3° or more front camber · race-spring coilovers required

e90-e92-e93.notes: Native ET29 rear replaces ET44 + 15mm spacer (effective ET29) for subframe clearance and greater fender clearance vs ET25. May require rolled rear fenders; many drivers remove rear fender liners. 295/35-18 rears may also be used. Subframe contact under full droop is still possible. 5mm front spacers may be required with certain aftermarket suspensions. Slick runners may opt for a 10.5" front for sidewall support.
e90-e92-e93.tireFlags: May require rolled rear fenders · native ET29 rear (no spacer)

g8x.notes: The go to OEM+ flush setup for the G8X chassis. The offset tucks the wheel in just enough for a clean, flush yet safe look while still maintaining strong concavity. Direct bolt-on stance  — no spacers needed.

A slightly narrower width and higher offset setup that keeps the wheels tucked in for a clean, OEM+ flush look with no poke. The 19" front improves steering feel and ride quality, while the 20" adds traction and a subtle bump in concavity. Direct bolt-on fitment that prioritizes drivability.

(Works with OEM tires)

Aggressive, flush fitment for the G8X chassis. Wider widths combined with lower offsets push the wheels outward to sit nearly even with the fenders, creating a strong, planted stance with maximum concavity. Direct bolt-on with no spacers needed, though proper tire sizing may be required for a perfectly dialed-in look.
g8x.tireFlags: X-Drive compatible · some front rubbing can occur against the inner fender liner at full steering lock

g8x.notes: Aggressive, performance-focused staggered fitment. The 19" front allows for better steering response, a lighter feel, and improved ride comfort, while the wider 20" rear increases rear grip and delivers a deeper concave profile. A balanced combination of daily drivability and enhanced traction — no spacers required.
g8x.tireFlags: Some front rubbing can occur against the inner fender liner at full steering lock

g8x.notes: An aggressive, track-inspired fitment. Running 19s all around keeps overall weight lower and improves ride compliance, ideal for spirited driving or performance use. The ET12 front sits near flush with a purposeful, planted look.

The ideal drag-focused fitment for the G8X chassis. The 18" beadlock rear pair sits properly within the fender at ET15 for a clean, planted look and remains a direct bolt-on with no clearance issues — designed for maximum straight-line traction. Pair with any Fortune Forged front wheel design; no spacers needed.
g8x.tireFlags: Rear beadlock pair · street-legal knurled bead alternative to full beadlocks available on request

g8x.notes: A fully race-oriented fitment for the G8X chassis. The 18" diameter increases sidewall for grip, compliance, and consistency under hard driving. The 18x11 ET15 rear is a direct bolt-on with a strong, planted stance, while the 18x10 ET12 front pushes the platform's limits and requires slight caliper clearance to properly seat the wheel. Best suited for track-focused builds where performance takes priority over convenience.
g8x.tireFlags: Requires slight front caliper clearance · aftermarket or trimmed fender liners recommended
